name: V3 planet-class production remainder restart verification

tests.name: Reauthenticate SysOp after actual serving-server restart
Verify all commodity remainders persisted across restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ore_production_remainder=1 AND organics_production_remainder=1 AND equipment_production_remainder=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=900 AND commodity_code IN ('ORE','ORG','EQU') AND quantity=0)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets WHERE planet_id=900;
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_due_at)::bigint FROM cron_tasks WHERE name='planet_growth';

tests.name: Run second actual planet production tick after restart
Second tick carries all three independent remainders to two

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.ore_production_remainder=2 AND p.organics_production_remainder=2 AND p.equipment_production_remainder=2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=900 AND commodity_code IN ('ORE','ORG','EQU') AND quantity=0)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p WHERE p.planet_id=900;
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_due_at)::bigint FROM cron_tasks WHERE name='planet_growth';

tests.name: Run third actual planet production tick after restart
Third tick converts each carried remainder into one persisted unit

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.ore_production_remainder=0 AND p.organics_production_remainder=0 AND p.equipment_production_remainder=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=900 AND commodity_code IN ('ORE','ORG','EQU') AND quantity=1)=3 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id=900 AND activity_type='production' AND commodity_code IN ('ORE','ORG','EQU') AND quantity=1)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p WHERE p.planet_id=900;
